notes: Skill IDs follow the build spec. outcomeRef values are Alberta 2022 Grade 3 learning outcomes. Place value in the spec is to 10 000; the official outcome is to 100 000 — left as specified until we reconcile.

nodes.title: Place value to 10 000
nodes.theme: Fuel tanks: thousands / hundreds / tens / ones tanks on the ship
levels: represent 4-digit numbers in more than one way

nodes.title: Addition and subtraction within 1000
nodes.outcomeRef: Students apply strategies for addition and subtraction within 1000.
nodes.theme: Cargo loading at the orbital depot

nodes.title: Multiplication and division within 100
nodes.outcomeRef: Students analyze and apply strategies for multiplication and division within 100.
nodes.theme: Solar panel arrays and crew pods

nodes.title: Fractions
nodes.outcomeRef: Students interpret fractions in relation to one whole.
levels: compare same denominator, then same numerator

nodes.title: Increasing and decreasing numerical sequences
nodes.outcomeRef: Students analyze patterns in numerical sequences.
nodes.theme: Navigation beacons along a flight path

nodes.title: Multiples and skip counting
nodes.outcomeRef: Students analyze patterns in numerical sequences.
levels: skip count from a non-zero start

nodes.title: Equality and equations with an unknown
nodes.theme: Airlock balance beam — both sides must match or the door won't open

nodes.title: Polygons: sides, vertices, classification
nodes.outcomeRef: Students relate geometric properties to shape.

nodes.title: Transformations and symmetry
nodes.outcomeRef: Students relate geometric properties to shape.
nodes.theme: Satellite panels and mirrored hull plating
levels: predict the result of a transformation

nodes.title: Length, units and referents
nodes.outcomeRef: Students determine length using standard units.

nodes.title: Perimeter
nodes.outcomeRef: Students determine length using standard units.

nodes.title: Angles
levels: smaller or larger than a right angle

nodes.title: a.m./p.m. and the 24-hour cycle
nodes.theme: Station day/night as you orbit Earth 16 times a day

nodes.title: Collect, organize and interpret first-hand data
